$description: Retrospect design tokens v1. One source of truth: Swift and Figma are generated from this file, never hand-edited. Semantic names say what a token is FOR, never what it looks like. Each semantic token's $value is light mode; $extensions.retrospect.dark is dark mode. source: 'paywall' = measured from PodcastPaywallFlow.swift (Figma 303:711); 'lime' = Lime's structure/value; 'to set' = a default for the founder to refine.

snappy.$description: Firm and immediate, ~1% overshoot: press release, toggles, segmented thumb, checkmarks, tab icon.

settle.$description: Dragged through water, ~5% overshoot: tiles lagging the scroll, off-axis cards settling on appear.

pop.$description: Delight, ~10% overshoot, used rarely: knows-you-well, a goal met, first episode ready, badges.

gentle.$description: Big and calm, no overshoot: large layout changes, the page behind a sheet.

dismissDistance.$description: Drag a sheet down this far, or flick faster than dismissVelocity, and it closes.

dismissVelocity.$description: Points per second that count as a flick down.

rubberBand.$description: How much a sheet resists being pulled up past its top (iOS-like).

scrubSnap.$description: A held scrub this close to a part's start lands on the start.

retrospect.source: docs/team/ui/C25.md (snap to a part start within 12pt)

scrubFineStep.$description: Dragging a scrub this far off the line halves its rate; twice as far quarters it (the iOS rule).

enter.$description: A menu or sheet arriving is blurred this much and sharpens as it settles.

retrospect.source: to set: from the title-menu recording (20 Oct)

rise.$description: How far an appearing item rises into place.

blurFrom.$description: Blur an appearing item sharpens from.

distance.$description: Horizontal travel of an error shake (three oscillations on snappy).

floatAmplitude.$description: Ambient drift of toasts and nodes (§7). Never more than 3pt.

floatPeriod.$description: One full float cycle. Never under 4s.

resumeAfter.$description: Ambient motion resumes this long after the last touch.

maxOffset.$description: Most a tile lags behind the scroll.

maxTilt.$description: Most a tile tilts, in degrees, while the list moves.

staggerMax.$description: Stagger at most this many items; the rest arrive together.

tear.$description: The ticket tear (PI2): stick-slip through the perforation, a curved peel, the snap, a gravity fall and the body's recoil.

threshold.$description: A release past this share of the perforation commits the tear.

flickVelocity.$description: A rightward flick faster than this (points a second) commits the tear.

wander.$description: The finger may wander this far off the perforation before the drag ends as a release.

tickGap.$description: At most one hole click per this long on a fast tear.

droopMax.$description: Degrees: the end angle of a fully torn flap (the tip's tangent; the flap curves to it).

retrospect.source: founder 26 Oct: TEAR.motion proposal (pipeline/qa/TEAR.motion/PROPOSAL.md) and direct answers (droop 11° as a curve)

droopExponent.$description: The droop grows with the torn length to this power (a short cantilever's sag).

retrospect.source: founder 26 Oct: TEAR.motion proposal (pipeline/qa/TEAR.motion/PROPOSAL.md) and direct answers (droop 11° as a curve)

curveExponent.$description: The flap's bend along its length: the tangent turns as 1 - (1 - s/L)^n, so most of the curve sits at the peel and the tip runs straight (a cantilever under its own weight).

retrospect.source: founder 26 Oct: TEAR.motion proposal (pipeline/qa/TEAR.motion/PROPOSAL.md) and direct answers (droop 11° as a curve)

pullMax.$description: Degrees of extra droop when the finger pulls a full wander below the line.

retrospect.source: founder 26 Oct: TEAR.motion proposal (pipeline/qa/TEAR.motion/PROPOSAL.md) and direct answers (droop 11° as a curve)

leanMax.$description: While a bridge holds, the ticket leans this far toward the finger.

liftKick.$description: Scale a second: the stub lifts toward you as it lets go, then lands.

press.$description: A primary or destructive action pressed (once, on touch down).

controlsWidth.$description: The width of grouped transport controls.

focusOffset.$description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

disabled.$description: Anything that cannot be used right now (when not using text.disabled).

pressed.$description: Content inside a control while pressed.

dimmed.$description: Things not related to what you selected (the map).

pending.$description: Something of yours on its way: a message sending, a save in flight. Same value as opacity.pressed, different meaning.

declined.$description: A guess you said isn't right: it stays readable but steps back from the thread.

skeletonPulseFloor.$description: With Reduce Motion, skeleton bars pulse 1 → this → 1 instead of the shine.

weight.$description: SF Symbols weight for ordinary icons.

weightEmphasis.$description: SF Symbols weight for selected tabs and key actions.

inner.$description: Inner stroke, 1pt inset all round: the lit edge of paper. Paired with the outer stroke, always.

innerTop.$description: The top of the inner stroke, 1pt brighter: light from above.

outer.$description: Outer stroke, 0.5pt outside: the warm hairline that defines the edge on paper.

retrospect.darkNote: M12, 20 Oct: was rgba(0,0,0,0.55), invisible on the night canvas, so canvas-coloured cards lost their edge; surfaces.md rule 7 says strokes invert to faint white in dark.

rim.$description: The ticket's outside edge. Light: the outer stroke's warm hairline (same value). Night: a faint light rim, because a dark shadow vanishes on the night canvas and the paper would sink into it.

contact.$description: The shallow shadow: 0 1 1.5. Seats the object on the page. Warm, never grey.

cast.$description: The warm soft shadow: y and blur grow with height, negative spread keeps it under the object.

ambient.$description: A very wide, faint layer for floating things (mini-player, menus, sheets).

sunken.$description: The inner shade of a sunken surface: inset 0 1 2, darkest at the top edge, as if light falls into it.

primary.$description: A lit primary action casts sky, not grey: a blurred, offset copy of its own gradient.

danger.$description: The destructive action casts its own red.

success.$description: The success action casts its own green.

artwork.$description: Artwork casts its dominant colour (computed per image; this is the default for the sky art).

flat.$description: On the page: no shadow, outer stroke only (rows, tags).

card.$description: Resting on the page: cards, chips, the brief card.

raised.$description: Lifted: the play well, the thumb, the mark.

lit.$description: The lit action: contact, its own coloured cast (replacing grey), and the halo.

listening.$description: The voice composer while listening or thinking: the contact under the bar and four soft, offset glows outside it (light moving, not a ring). Drawn outside the bar only.

pressed.$description: The cream raised pill pressed: the shadow collapses toward the page.

boxShadow.$description: Paper's box-shadow stacks exactly as Paper writes them (CSS: x, y, blur, spread; inset layers marked inset; first layer on top). planMonthly.$description: The raised monthly plan button: top light, outer hairline, contact.

planYearly.$description: The lit yearly plan button: rim, edge and bloom inside, the ring, and the halo pulled in by its spread (Paper keeps the halo on this screen: founder 26 Oct night, PW-Q4 A).

saveBadge.$description: The "save" badge on the lit plan: a primary ring hairline and contact.

tileField.$description: The tiny sunken search field drawn in the "ask" tile.

tileGlowSun.$description: The halo round the lit sun in the "brief" tile.

tileGlowYou.$description: The halo round the lit "you" node in the "map" tile.

tileGlowPlay.$description: The halo under the lit play in the "podcast" tile.

z.$description: The surface ladder. Every component sits at exactly one height, and its height says its purpose: the higher it sits, the more attention it asks for. Attention is spent, not sprinkled.

sunken.$value: −1 · inset · background.sunken + inner shade (inset 0 1 2 warm 8%, inset 0 0 0 0.5 warm 6%)
sunken.$description: Things you put something into: text fields, the composer, search, tracks, the transport tray, the segmented track.

page.$description: Content itself: text, transcripts, rows. Never raised; reading text never floats.

wash.$description: Quiet, low-commitment things: tags, status, bubbles (icon actions), pills like "chapters", selected-row highlights. They tint the page instead of sitting on it.

card.$description: Groupings you can open or that belong together: the brief card, chips, list cards, paywall benefit drawings.

raised.$description: The thing your finger grabs or the alternative you might choose: switch and scrubber thumbs, the segmented thumb, the play well, the cream secondary, the mark.

floating.$description: Persistent tools above content: the mini-player, menus, toasts.

overlay.$description: Temporary and modal: sheets, dialogs, the player.

lit.$description: The one next step on the screen: the primary action, the talk button, the brief play. One per screen.

gradient.$description: Every gradient in the app. Rules: interpolate in OKLCH; ease the stops (smoothstep, 5 or more stops); never ramp between distant hues — use mesh blobs that fade in alpha over a base instead; anything larger than 44pt carries grain (soft light, 3–6%) so it never bands on an OLED screen.

glowPrimary.$description: The lit action body. Five eased stops, so the light rolls off rather than steps.

glowPrimaryLit.$description: Focused body, under the lit highlights.

fadeToCanvas.$description: Content fading under floating controls and into the transport. Eased so there is no visible line where the fade starts.
